reason: The README describes a resizable right-side panel that provides isolated agentic chats, transfers selected conversation context and question-dialog options, and can return replies to the main conversation; it may also access the workspace under configured permissions.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 提供与主会话隔离的右侧智能体聊天面板，可基于选中文本或问题弹框进行分析，并将回复带回主会话。
summaries.en: Adds an isolated right-side agent chat panel for DSH that can analyze selected text or question-dialog options and bring responses back to the main conversation.

capabilities: inherits the parent conversation's model, tools, working directory, and permission preset
may read workspace and parent-conversation records when enabled
inserts or summarizes side-chat replies into the main conversation
handles selected message text and question-dialog options
